description: This is a false-colour infrared (FCIR) satellite image showcasing an urbanized area alongside a body of water, likely a river or bay. In this FCIR composition, dense vegetation appears as bright red, artificial surfaces such as buildings, roads, and other impervious areas are depicted in tones of grey and blue, and water bodies are dark blue to black. A prominent light blue polygon boundary delineates a densely built-up urban core, within which the label "1110" is clearly visible in light blue text. This designated area, characterized by a high concentration of artificial surfaces and a complex road network, likely represents a land cover class such as "Continuous Urban Fabric" or "Dense Urban fabric" within a Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) or CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classification framework, reflecting its high Imperviousness Density (IM.D.). The image includes a visible bridge or elevated road structure crossing the water body.
